---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, verifiable capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User task

What real Godot task should become easier or safer?

## Minimal operation

What exact target, input shape, allowlist, revision guard, and rollback evidence would be sufficient?

## Safety boundary

Why is this narrower than arbitrary GDScript, shell, filesystem writes, or Godot RPC?

## Verification

Describe the unit test, fixture smoke, and Godot version coverage that would prove it works.
